messages:
Nina (Design): quick check on how preview should handle route-chaining + per-route suppression. current mock flattens recipients and hides which route created them. link: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/route-chain.png
Omar (PM): users keep asking "who created this notification?" when multiple rules touch the same alert. we need provenance: which routing rule produced each recipient.
Luca (Frontend): doable. proposal: show recipient rows with a small badge 'via <rule-name>' and collapse duplicate endpoints into one row with a stacked-badge showing all contributing rules. keyboard: rows must be focusable and expandable.
Maya (Accessibility): accessibility: the provenance badge should be included in the aria-label for each recipient row, e.g. `Slack #ops, via primary-route`. if a recipient is suppressed, prefix with '(Suppressed)'. don't rely on color.
Chris (SRE): also important: suppression can be route-scoped or global. preview should indicate if suppression applies at route-level vs global-level. maybe show 'suppressed by: <entity>' text.
Nina (Design): UX debate: when multiple rules map to same endpoint (eg slack webhook used by two rules), should we merge into one recipient row with "via rule-A + rule-B" or show separate rows? merging reduces clutter but hides which rule will be un-suppressed first.
Omar (PM): prefer merge with an affordance to "show rule breakdown". default compact view merged, expanded view shows each rule and suppression state.
Luca (Frontend): implementation: compact view shows endpoint + up to 2 rule badges then '+N rules' button that expands. expansion lazily fetches server-resolved breakdown and shows suppression status per rule. spinner while loading.
Maya (Accessibility): the '+N rules' control must be keyboard focusable and have `aria-expanded`. when expanded, announce details in aria-live region. also ensure focus moves into expanded list.
Chris (SRE): backend note: API will return `resolvedRecipients` objects like:
```
[{
  "endpoint": "slack:#ops",
  "rules": [
    {"name":"primary-route","suppressed_by":"maintenance-2024-06"},
    {"name":"page-escalation","suppressed_by":null}
  ]
}]
```
We should include `suppressed_by` with id + human reason.
Nina (Design): microcopy: header change across alert flows to "Alert when threshold is reached" (align with product). For suppression display, show: 'Suppressed — maintenance until Jun 24, 18:00 UTC' not just 'Suppressed'.
Luca (Frontend): dev story will show compact example and expanded breakdown. example UI payload I can use in story:
```
resolvedRecipients: [
  {endpoint: "slack:#ops", rules: ["primary-route (suppressed: maintenance)", "page-escalation"]},
  {endpoint: "pagerduty:infra-oncall", rules: ["p90-escalation"]}
]
```
And expansion is client-side lazy request to "/api/alerts/preview?expand=rules".
Maya (Accessibility): tooltip content must be accessible (focusable, keyboard dismissible). for suppressed rows, add `role=status` aria-live polite message when suppression toggles.
Omar (PM): UX copy for merge control: show '+N rules' as '+2 contributing rules' (explicit). and tooltip text: 'This endpoint is created by these routing rules'.
Nina (Design): quick prototyping note: initial compact shows up to 3 recipients then '+N more recipients' link. recipients that are merged show 'via <rule>' badges. expanded view shows rule-level suppression with human-readable reasons and timestamps.
ui-bot: figma updated https://figma.redwood.app/file/route-chain/preview-v1 (published to staging).
Chris (SRE): created ticket INF-5120 for preview API with resolvedRecipients + rule-level suppression.
Nina (Design): Decisions summary: 1) Compact merge duplicates with 'via' badges, expandable to rule breakdown 2) Show up to 3 recipients in preview + '+N more recipients' focusable 3) Expansion lazy-loads rule-level details with spinner 4) Suppression displayed inline with reason + end time and prefixed for SR users 5) All controls keyboardable with aria-expanded and aria-live announcements 6) Copy change: 'Alert when threshold is reached' 7) Backend returns `suppressed_by` metadata per rule. Owners: Luca (frontend) + Chris (backend) + Maya (a11y) + Nina (design). I'll close once figma + INF-5120 are linked in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
